notes.title: Updated the cheating chest!
notes.content:
You can find a mushroom on the left of the starting boat of the novice guide level
Touch the mushroom more and you can activate the cheating treasure chest

You can also find a broken stone pillar on the left side of the boat after skipping the first map guided by the novice
You can activate the cheating treasure chest by hitting the stone pillar more

After activating the cheating treasure chest, you can play this game more easily
However, cheating will affect the final score after customs clearance
